config.systemNotifications.enabled: Send native OS notifications when foreground or background work finishes (local Windows/macOS only). OS notification permissions and Focus settings apply.
config.systemNotifications.sound: Request a sound with system notifications. The operating system controls playback.
config.systemNotifications.includeConver: Include the conversation title in system notifications. Titles may be visible on the lock screen; reply content is never included.
extension.description: A native DeepSeek Harness coding agent for VS Code. Uses the local Harness Gateway without requiring a separate deployment.
command.openChatWindow: DeepSeek Harness: Open Workbench in New Window
config.model: Default model for new Harness sessions.
config.model.flash: DeepSeek V4 Flash for faster responses.
config.model.pro: DeepSeek V4 Pro for complex coding and long reasoning chains.
config.reasoning.low: Low reasoning effort for faster answers.
config.preset: Default official Harness Agent Preset for new sessions.
config.preset.code: PTC: compose multi-step tool operations through the Code Mode SDK.
config.preset.cordis: Creator: inspect the runtime and create custom Agent Presets.
config.provider: Default provider route selected from the extension's Connection settings panel.
config.permission: Default Harness file-access and approval policy.
config.permission.readOnly: Prevent Harness tools from writing files.
config.permission.workspaceWrite: Allow writes only in the current workspace and runtime temporary directories.
config.permission.dangerFullAccess: Do not apply Harness filesystem sandbox restrictions.
config.autoAttachSelection: Automatically stage the active editor selection as a visible prompt context card. Set to `false` to attach selections only with the “⬒ Selection” button.
config.webSearch: Enable the built-in DeepSeek web-search provider so the Agent can search the web. Takes effect after a workbench reload.
config.experimentalAutoEffort: Enable experimental auto reasoning effort mode to dynamically scale reasoning tokens based on task signals.
config.worktreeAutoMerge: When an isolated session's conversation turn finishes, automatically merge its changes back into the main branch and working tree.
config.worktreeAutoMerge.never: Keep the manual Review / Merge back / Discard triage only.
config.worktreeAutoMerge.onTurnEnd: Merge the session's worktree back into the base branch after each completed turn (safe when the main working tree is clean; a dirty main working tree is never overwritten).
